title: Accept `"type": ""` tool calls
body:
### Description

The OpenAI Compatible provider currently has two layers to verify that every tool call has a `type` of `"function"`:
https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/9e16bfddb83e2d0158deb67eeec3b9e07344631b/packages/openai-compatible/src/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts#L500-L505
https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/9e16bfddb83e2d0158deb67eeec3b9e07344631b/packages/openai-compatible/src/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts#L700

But these checks are unnecessary and serve no purpose since the "function" is the only type of tool call OpenAI's ever declared. More importantly, they prevent me from using the OpenAI Compatible provider from connecting to Novita AI, a provider that sets the type of tool calls to `""` after the first one, like it's a delta. Novita isn't changing how their API works - they're confident that this "complies with OpenAI guidelines", and it makes some intuitive sense (it is in the delta section of the stream after all). To solve this, these checks will have to be removed.

## Background

Some openai compatible providers do not send `type: "function"`

## Summary

Remove check for type function.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7255

This fits "Tool-related issues" and "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
